purpose: Map P0 sounds to future temporal behavior without implementing new Sprint 5 gameplay.

event_types.passive: Continuous or naturally evolving world sound that does not require context interaction.
event_types.triggered: Discrete world event caused by an interaction or scripted event.
event_types.moving: World event whose source position/level changes over time.
event_types.device: Recorder mechanical feedback; diegetic but not a normal collectible world source.

events.trigger: tutorial/presentation event while Malo is near Ronan
events.temporal_rule: Only content occurring between REC and STOP should belong to a future temporal capture.
Primary role is immediate diegetic feedback. Any later self-recording bleed is device-profile behavior, not a collectible source.
Lives outside normal world-source collection. Playback mechanics must never feed the normal capture bus by accident.

events.trigger: always/naturally evolving while fireplace is active
events.temporal_rule: Captured segment must correspond to the actual REC interval; no automatic replacement with a full ambience file.
Latch/hinge portions that occur before REC or after STOP are absent from the stored temporal capture.
Player waits for and chooses a time window; quiet/rough captures remain valid.
Continuous hum can overlap triggered fridge-door events in one recording.
Late start or early stop creates a partial valid pass-by recording; never substitute the full source event.
